Sound once witnessed crowds gathering around a towering drum during festivals. Each time the mallet struck, waves of cheers surged forward with the sound. 
Time after time, Sound leapt from above, striking the drum with its paws. The deep booms pierced through the heavy snow blanketing Liangzhou. Yet not once did a single soul come rushing to the drum. 
The final strike cracked the drumhead. Sound tumbled inside, aching all over. 
Between dream and waking, gentle hands lifted Sound and held it close to a warm heart. It heard a steady heartbeat—the same deep rhythm as the drum it once played.

Shoushou is a master of winning hearts. 
The moment someone appears, it flops onto her side, meowing nonstop and rubbing eagerly against them. It never bites or lashes out—who could resist an invitation like that? 
For many weary travelers, the gentle touch of Shoushou's soft fur is the only comfort on a long and lonely road. 
In those brief moments, as hands glide through its silky coat, pain, anger, and troubles fade away— 
the world shrinking down to just this tender exchange. 
Soft, warm, and endlessly comforting—Shoushou truly is a remarkable cat. 
If only she didn't take advantage of distracted travelers by stealthily snatching their dry food and loose coins, she might be perfect.
